title: Morning Pages
tone: Warm, curious, practical. An invitation to explore, not a substitute for the source.

categories.name: Tech
categories.lens: Separate what was demonstrated from what is promised. Look for the measurement, the comparison, and the constraints before deciding what a new technology changes.

categories.name: Programming
categories.lens: Read the compatibility notes before changing a working project. Try the smallest example on a separate branch, write down the result, and keep a way to roll back.

categories.name: Guitar
categories.lens: Turn inspiration into a small practice experiment. Choose one sound or technique, slow it down until it is comfortable, and listen to a recording rather than judging by speed.

categories.name: New Music
categories.lens: Listen once without multitasking. Then revisit the arrangement: which instrument establishes the pulse, what changes between sections, and which sound creates the emotional center?

categories.name: Philosophy & Reading
categories.lens: Write the claim in your own words, identify its strongest reason, and imagine a fair objection. Understanding an argument does not require agreeing with it.

categories.name: Training & Health
categories.lens: Ask who was studied, what was measured, and whether the result applies to your circumstances. One study is a starting point for questions, not a personal training prescription.

categories.name: Anime & Manga
categories.lens: Check the region, format, and official announcement before treating a release date as a promise. For recommendations, separate your taste from a claim about universal quality.
